name: Deino
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, Deino trains Horde mages in the arcane arts. She teaches spellcasters to master arcane and elemental forces, and sends seasoned mages across Kalimdor to study ancient magic and seek remote tutors.

sections.title: The Valley's Arcanist
sections.body: Deino trains Horde mages in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Totems, huts, and quiet waters surround the raised platforms where she teaches. Troll spellcasters balance spiritual reverence with arcane mastery, a path Deino shares with fellow instructors Enyo and Pephredo.

sections.title: Unraveling Arcane Mysteries
sections.body: Deino sends promising mages beyond Durotar to study arcane mysteries. In Ashenvale's corrupted wilds, they gather tainted Waters of Xavian and enchanted hair from the Laughing Sisters. When a student's power outgrows Orgrimmar's instruction, Deino directs them to remote masters, including Tabetha, a hermit sorceress in Dustwallow's swamplands.

faq.answer: Deino stands on raised platforms in the Valley of Spirits, in southwestern Orgrimmar. Fellow troll mage trainers Enyo and Pephredo stand with her.
Deino teaches arcane, fire, and frost spells, portal creation, and essential spell ranks as mages gain experience.

faq.q: Why does Deino send mages to Xavian?
faq.answer: Xavian is an ancient city in eastern Ashenvale, now held by satyrs. Its waters are said to hold great magical power, and Deino wants a sample from the bottom of its highest waterfall for study.

faq.q: Who are the trainers standing with Deino?
aliases: troll mages in valley of spirits
faq.answer: Enyo and Pephredo stand with Deino. The three share the names of the Graeae sisters of ancient myth and form Orgrimmar's central circle of troll mage mentors.

faq.q: Why does Deino send mages to Dustwallow Marsh?
faq.answer: When a mage grows more skilled, Deino sends them to Tabetha, a powerful, reclusive human hermit deep in Dustwallow Marsh. Tabetha holds specialized arcane secrets.
Yes. Horde mages of any race, including trolls, orcs, and Forsaken, can learn class spells and receive guidance from Deino in the Valley of Spirits.

angles.text: As a mage, you can learn spells and portal magic from Deino in Orgrimmar, then study in Ashenvale and Dustwallow Marsh.
As a troll, you can see how the Darkspear combine scholarly arcane magic with the traditions of the Valley of Spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you can find Deino in Orgrimmar's spiritual district, where she trains the faction's spellcasters alongside its shamans and warlocks.
